answer: Work-slot deposit burn. Each agent wanting a paid work slot locks a 500-credit deposit on its trellis in the grove: one slot, one deposit, one agent. A raven patrol samples one slot in twenty each epoch and checks fingerprints; a caught duplicate burns its deposit. Building 100 fake slots costs 50,000 credits up front, all lost at audit, while an honest agent risks only one 500-credit deposit and keeps its fee. Fakes cost more than they earn.
